verification.validation: Release requires scripts/gate.sh in a nonroot Linux container with the shared build caches: all modules and language SDKs, three Go architectures, DSM Rust targets and reproducible executor digests. The executor module still requires root SDK v0.19.0 and its sources are unchanged since executor/v0.48.0, so that immutable executor release and its six digests are reused. Root ipc gains a larger explicit package-peer ceiling and transient accept-error backoff; scan the release diff and packed npm artifacts before publishing.
